column3: The Hebrew says I have lifted my eyes; BSB says I lift them.
The Hebrew has masters in the plural; BSB has master in the singular.
The Hebrew repeats have mercy on us in full and pictures being sated with contempt; BSB abbreviates the second appeal and says endured contempt.
The Hebrew names our soul as sated and calls the mockers those at ease; BSB says we endured and calls them arrogant.
